exposure: Patients were stratified by the presence or absence of adverse maternal outcomes, including intrapartum/peripartum bleeding >1000 mL and/or emergency hysterectomy after abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (AABO).
cohort: 80 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders who underwent abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (AABO).
finding: Short cervical length, abnormal intraplacental vascularity, placental bulge, and myometrial interruption on MRI were independent risk factors for adverse maternal outcomes in patients with PAS disorders after AABO.
